answer: Fingerprint the model behind each answer: token timing, sampling temperature, a hash of the prompt path. Identical fingerprints across many identities mean one operator, and the payout converts to a slow vesting stream instead of a lump sum. A second reader with no stake re-checks the sample. In the meadow test, 260 accounts shared one garden of fingerprints and their stream stopped at epoch four. One signal, one reader, no appeal.
